title: Browser relay v1
description: Strict browser-only HTTP/SSE DTOs. Authority is carried in authenticated headers, never in model arguments. Only owner-turn-shot data persists. Image decoding, URL policy, byte budgets, exact matching, and monotonic deadlines remain runtime checks.

ownerActivity.description: True only for trusted owner input/focus since the preceding heartbeat. Receipt time is assigned by Management; no client timestamp is accepted.

agentOpenApproval.description: browser_open approval. ask = the owner approves each new page, except for agents running with full access (sandbox danger-full-access + approval never; capability browser-open-full-access). browser_claim always asks.

settings.description: Browser group within existing GET/PATCH /v2/settings; additionally offlineMs must be at least 3 * heartbeatMs.
